issues.on_page: Enterprise Fund - Sewer line 21 Total Receipts 78,573.00 = Local Receipts: Other 77,738.00 + line 20 Transfers In Other Than Surplus Fees 835.00
issues.issue: The printed total includes the printed transfer line, which is recorded as business_type.transfers_net +835. That would normally be includes: ["transfers_net"]. includes_split is meant for hidden transfers split out of a printed line. The transfer is still counted only once and the arithmetic holds.
